title: Did you know… Moses’ calling began in an ordinary moment?
paragraphs: Did you know… Moses’ calling began in an ordinary moment?

He wasn’t praying.
He wasn’t fasting.
He wasn’t even looking for God.
Moses was just… working.

A shepherd.
In the wilderness.
Tending someone else’s sheep.

Ordinary.
Forgotten.
Hidden.
And then—fire.

A bush burning… but not consumed.
No choir. No temple. No crowd.
Just God… breaking into a normal day.

Exodus 3 wasn’t a church service.
It was a work shift.
And that’s where everything changed.
Because here’s what we miss—

God doesn’t wait for perfect moments.
He invades ordinary ones.

Moses had a past full of failure.
A murderer. A runaway. A man in hiding.
Forty years of silence.
But heaven wasn’t done with him.

“Take off your sandals…”
Holy ground… in the middle of nowhere.

And in that moment, God didn’t just speak—
He called.

Not because Moses was ready.
But because God is.
That’s the Gospel pattern.

You don’t clean yourself up to be called.
You are called… and then God cleans you.

Through Jesus, the same fire that didn’t consume the bush
now burns with mercy instead of judgment.

Your past doesn’t cancel your calling.
Your ordinary doesn’t disqualify your destiny.

God still shows up in random Tuesdays.
In quiet routines.
In unnoticed places.
So don’t despise your “just another day.”
It might be your burning bush moment.

And when He speaks—
Answer.
Because grace is calling your name.
